checks: Same-ID swords remain independent; invalid slots and duplicate/null objects cannot change membership or selection; bag exposes no writable list
Durability, refill and skill mutations accept only owned equipment; single and full refills target the intended instances
Sales/feed removal rejects the equipped object; removing earlier slots preserves selected identity; stale/repeated removals cannot consume a replacement
Script removal reuses the original first ID-0 fallback; missing IDs do nothing; removing the active starter creates exactly one replacement
First-ID removal retains original duplicate-starter fallback semantics; removing an earlier unequipped starter never creates or selects a replacement
Capture/Restore detach mutable reinforcement, durability and skill fields; null/empty/partial snapshots are rejected before live state changes
Restore clamps legacy selected indices without rerolling random skills or advancing Unity random state
Reinforcement accepts exact balance, uses selected live durability ratio, charges once and upgrades skill at +5; insufficient money changes neither instance nor balance
Unequipped reinforcement preserves its own durability ratio; +9 doubles base stats, grants original skill step, and cap/restricted/foreign instances never charge
